from common import *
import pandas as pd

if __name__=='__main__':
    register_adapter(__file__)
    label,rule=sys.argv[1:3]
    assert label in ['old','new','hybrid'] and rule in ['s5','ladder']
    state=read(STATE);plan=read(PLAN)
    assert len(state['account_jobs'])<plan['budget']['max_account_jobs']
    assert not any(j['status']=='running' for j in state['jobs']+state['account_jobs'])
    assert time.time()<state['deadline']
    if label=='new':pred=ROOT/'backtest/result/20261105_horizon_p50/h20/ensemble.pkl'
    else:pred=ROOT/f'backtest/result/20261106_p50_stability/{label}-ensemble.pkl'
    config=BASE/'configs'/('fixed-s5.yaml' if rule=='s5' else 'derived-ladder-k3h5.yaml')
    note=f'p50stable_20261106_{label}_{rule}'
    result_root=ROOT/'backtest/result';before={p.name for p in result_root.iterdir()}
    job={'job_id':note,'label':label,'rule':rule,'status':'running','started_at':time.time(),'source_pred':fingerprint(pred),'config':fingerprint(config),'pid':os.getpid()}
    state['account_jobs'].append(job);write(STATE,state)
    try:
        import qlib
        from backtest.scripts.evaluate import run_pred_backtest as bt
        from backtest.scripts.evaluate.strategy_stability_metrics import summarize_stability,load_regime_labels
        from backtest.scripts.train.train_regime_arm import frame_signature
        original_init=qlib.init
        def init(*a,**kw):kw['kernels']=1;return original_init(*a,**kw)
        qlib.init=init
        original_prepare=bt.prepare_signal_and_port_cfg
        def prepare(cfg,raw):
            port,filtered,stats=original_prepare(cfg,raw)
            write(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-{label}-{rule}-signal.json',{'source':fingerprint(pred),'raw':frame_signature(raw),'filtered':frame_signature(filtered),'filter_stats':stats})
            return port,filtered,stats
        bt.prepare_signal_and_port_cfg=prepare
        sys.argv=['run_pred_backtest.py','--pred',str(pred),'--config',str(config),'--note',note,'--skip-pred-copy']
        bt.main()
        created=[p for p in result_root.iterdir() if p.name not in before and p.name.endswith(note)]
        assert len(created)==1,created
        session=created[0];link=read(session/'run_01/mlruns_link.json')
        report_path=ROOT/link['backtest_artifacts']/'artifacts/portfolio_analysis/report_normal_1day.pkl'
        report=pd.read_pickle(report_path)
        regimes=ROOT/'backtest/experiments/strategies/topk-dropout/v2-top5-hold-f100/variants/bt-v5/configs/monthly_regime_labels_eval_window_v1.csv'
        metrics=summarize_stability(report,load_regime_labels(regimes))
        portable=BASE/'data'/f'{PREFIX}-{label}-{rule}-account.pkl';report.to_pickle(portable)
        metrics['session_dir']=str(session.relative_to(ROOT));metrics['portable_report']=str(portable.relative_to(ROOT))
        doc={'model_ref':plan['parent_exp_id']+'/arms/h20/'+label,'seeds':[42,1000,2000,3000,4000],'data_version':'2026-11-03','evaluation_mode':'historical_selection_window','source_prediction':fingerprint(pred),'session_dir':str(session.relative_to(ROOT)),'ensemble':metrics,'source_report':fingerprint(report_path),'selection_limitation':'Fixed one rule, no tuning. Reconstructed old signals are identified separately from deleted historical models.'}
        out=BASE/'metrics'/f'{PREFIX}-{label}-{rule}.json';write(out,doc)
        state=read(STATE);state['account_jobs'][-1].update(status='succeeded',finished_at=time.time(),evidence=fingerprint(out),session=str(session.relative_to(ROOT)));write(STATE,state)
        print(json.dumps(metrics['full_period'],indent=2))
    except BaseException as e:
        import traceback
        path=BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-{label}-{rule}-failure.json';write(path,{'error':repr(e),'traceback':traceback.format_exc(),'job':job})
        state=read(STATE);state['account_jobs'][-1].update(status='failed',finished_at=time.time(),evidence=fingerprint(path));write(STATE,state)
        raise
